title: 冬のくらしの人物イラスト
subject_en: People in winter scenes, each a separate full-body figure, faceless style (no facial features at all, smooth oval face), flat simple shapes, varied ages, genders and skin tones, natural poses Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
